notes: Input focus diagnostic logging: — both the Discovery Engine keyword input and Proxy Chains rename input now log every focus, blur, mount, unmount, and keydown event to the DevTools console. Also includes a 1-second focus watcher that re-focuses the input if focus is stolen by an async re-render (up to 10 attempts at 100ms intervals). Open DevTools (Ctrl+Shift+I) and look for `[DEBUG] SearchInput` / `[DEBUG] RenameInput` messages to help diagnose the intermittent focus issue.
